title: Help Center
subtitle: Find answers and get support
faqAccessEmail: How do I access my email?
faqAccessEmailAnswer: Click 'Continue with SSO' on the login page to authenticate via Keycloak. Once authenticated, you'll be redirected to your inbox automatically.
faqBrowsersAnswer: Omnixys Mail supports all modern browsers including Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+, and Edge 90+. We recommend keeping your browser up to date for the best experience.
faqCompose: How do I compose a new email?
faqComposeAnswer: Click the 'Compose' button in the mail toolbar or use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+N. A compose drawer will open at the bottom of the screen where you can write your message.
faqSearch: How do I search for emails?
faqSearchAnswer: Use the search bar at the top of the message list. You can search by sender, subject, or content. Use advanced operators like 'from:', 'subject:', and 'has:attachment' for precise filtering.
faqFolders: Can I organize emails into folders?
faqFoldersAnswer: Yes! Use the mailbox tree on the left to navigate folders. You can create custom folders, move emails between them, and set up sieve filters for automatic organization.
faqFilters: How do I set up email filters?
faqFiltersAnswer: Navigate to Settings > Sieve Filters to create rules that automatically sort, forward, or categorize incoming mail based on sender, subject, or content patterns.
faqShortcuts: Does Omnixys Mail support keyboard shortcuts?
faqShortcutsAnswer: Yes! Common shortcuts include: Ctrl+N (new message), R (reply), A (reply all), F (forward), E (archive), and Delete (move to trash). Press ? to see all shortcuts.
faqEmailProtectedAnswer: All connections use TLS 1.3 encryption. Emails are signed with DKIM and verified with SPF/DMARC. Your account is secured via Keycloak SSO with optional two-factor authentication.
faqDkim: What is DKIM and how do I set it up?
faqDkimAnswer: DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) cryptographically signs outgoing emails to verify they haven't been tampered with. Admins can manage DKIM keys in Admin > DKIM Settings.
faq2faAnswer: Yes! Go to Settings > Security and click 'Enable 2FA'. You can use authenticator apps (TOTP) or hardware security keys for an additional layer of protection.
faqAddDomain: How do I add a new domain?
faqAddDomainAnswer: Go to Admin > Domains and click 'Add Domain'. Enter your domain name, configure MX records pointing to the Stalwart server, and set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records for optimal deliverability.
faqManageUsers: How do I manage user accounts?
faqManageUsersAnswer: Navigate to Admin > Users to create, edit, or disable accounts. You can assign roles, set storage quotas, and manage permissions for each user.
faqMonitorQueue: Where can I monitor mail queue and delivery?
faqMonitorQueueAnswer: Go to Admin > Queue to see the real-time mail queue with delivery status. Admin > Monitoring shows delivery throughput, latency metrics, and system health dashboards.
faqDisplayName: How do I change my display name?
faqDisplayNameAnswer: Go to Settings > Profile and click 'Edit Profile'. You can update your display name, avatar, and other personal information.
faqDarkMode: Can I switch between light and dark mode?
faqDarkModeAnswer: Yes! Go to Settings > Appearance and toggle the dark mode switch. You can also set it to 'System' to automatically match your operating system preference.
faqLanguage: How do I change the language?
faqLanguageAnswer: Navigate to Settings > Appearance and use the Language dropdown to switch between English (en) and Deutsch (de).
faqAddContactsAnswer: Go to Contacts and click 'Add Contact'. Fill in the contact details including name, email, phone, and organization. Contacts are synced with your JMAP account.
faqImportContacts: Can I import contacts from another provider?
faqImportContactsAnswer: Yes! Use the import function in Contacts to upload a vCard (.vcf) or CSV file. We support imports from Gmail, Outlook, Apple Contacts, and standard formats.
faqCalendarAnswer: The calendar provides a month view with event management. Click on any day to see or add events. Color-coding helps you distinguish between personal, work, and team events.
